label: Complaint workflow actions service
instruction: Generate initial CMS workflow action service in modules/complaint_cms/services/actions.py, maximum 110 lines. Provide act_on_complaint(actor, complaint_id, action, data) supporting actions acknowledge, start_progress, resolve, close, reopen, escalate, assign, and feedback. Reuse existing model fields from modules.complaint_cms.models, permission names from modules.complaint_cms.registry, and error classes from core.api.exceptions (PermissionDeniedError, DomainValidationError, ResourceNotFoundError). Update Complaint fields, record a ComplaintUpdate entry, update or create ComplaintTask as needed, and create a ComplaintNotification for the complainant inside transaction.atomic(). Return the updated Complaint. Return raw Python source only without code fences.
